zork1.title: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
zork1.description: Setting: a classic fantasy world of ruined castles, forests, and underground caverns. The Great Underground Empire.

zork2.title: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
zork2.description: Setting: the same fantasy underground empire as Zork I, ruled by the Wizard of Frobozz. Dungeons, castles, and whimsical magical rooms.

zork3.title: Zork III: The Dungeon Master
zork3.description: Setting: the same fantasy underground empire, in its final, more solemn and eerie depths near the Dungeon Master's domain.

planetfall.title: Planetfall
planetfall.description: Setting: science fiction. A derelict starship and an abandoned, corroded underground colony complex on a distant planet. Metal corridors, control panels, industrial machinery. NOT a fantasy or medieval setting: no grass, trees, or pastoral scenery unless explicitly described in the scene text.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Setting: contemporary murder mystery. A wealthy family's private mansion and estate grounds, investigated over a single 12-hour day.

starcross.title: Starcross
starcross.description: Setting: science fiction. Deep space in the year 2186, aboard a huge derelict alien cylindrical spacecraft drifting among the stars.

suspended.title: Suspended
suspended.description: Setting: science fiction. A cryonic suspension chamber in an underground planetary control complex, experienced only through six differently-sensing robots.

enchanter.title: Enchanter
enchanter.description: Setting: fantasy. A magical kingdom of guildhalls and a sorcerer's ruined castle, focused on spellcasting rather than combat.

infidel.title: Infidel
infidel.description: Setting: 1980s archaeological adventure. A lost, undiscovered Egyptian pyramid buried beneath the Sahara desert.

sorcerer.title: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: Setting: fantasy. The same magical kingdom as Enchanter, centered on a guild of wizards and a hazy dream-realm of astral travel.

witness.title: The Witness
witness.description: Setting: 1938 Los Angeles film-noir murder mystery. A wealthy industrialist's home, told in hardboiled detective style.

cutthroats.title: Cutthroats
cutthroats.description: Setting: contemporary. A decayed New England fishing town and the cold waters around it, centered on shipwreck salvage diving.

seastalker.title: Seastalker
seastalker.description: Setting: near-future undersea adventure. An experimental research submarine and an undersea research station, with a lurking sense of danger from the deep, written for younger players.

spellbreaker.title: Spellbreaker
spellbreaker.description: Setting: fantasy. The same magical kingdom of the Enchanter trilogy, with reality itself unraveling as magic fails across the land.

hitchhikersguide.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
hitchhikersguide.description: Setting: absurdist science fiction comedy. Alien bureaucracy, improbable spaceships, and a chaotic tour of a very silly galaxy.

mindforevervoyaging.title: A Mind Forever Voyaging
mindforevervoyaging.description: Setting: near-future dystopian science fiction. A simulated American town observed across decades from inside a sentient computer.

wishbringer.title: Wishbringer
wishbringer.description: Setting: fantasy. A quaint fishing village that transforms into a sinister, magic-corrupted town, involving a wish-granting stone.

leathergoddesses.title: Leather Goddesses of Phobos
leathergoddesses.description: Setting: 1930s pulp science-fiction parody. Small-town America, Mars, and the moon Phobos, styled after campy pulp serials.

trinity.title: Trinity
trinity.description: Setting: a surreal, dreamlike blend of an English garden and shifting fantastical realms, with an undercurrent of Cold War-era unease.

ballyhoo.title: Ballyhoo
ballyhoo.description: Setting: contemporary traveling circus. Big top tents, sideshow attractions, animal cages, and backstage circus grounds.

suspect.title: Suspect
suspect.description: Setting: contemporary murder mystery. A wealthy Maryland family's mansion during a Halloween costume party.

lurkinghorror.title: The Lurking Horror
lurkinghorror.description: Setting: Lovecraftian horror. A large American university campus, its steam tunnels and computer labs, during a snowstorm.

nordandbert.title: Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It
nordandbert.description: Setting: whimsical wordplay fantasy. The town of Punster, where idioms, puns, and clichés become literal, physical realities.

moonmist.title: Moonmist
moonmist.description: Setting: contemporary gothic mystery. A foggy, atmospheric English castle on the Cornwall coast, steeped in local legend.

stationfall.title: Stationfall
stationfall.description: Setting: science fiction. A seemingly deserted space station, sequel to Planetfall, with the same robot companion Floyd.

hollywoodhijinx.title: Hollywood Hijinx
hollywoodhijinx.description: Setting: contemporary. A lavish Malibu, California oceanfront mansion filled with campy B-movie props and memorabilia.

bureaucracy.title: Bureaucracy
bureaucracy.description: Setting: contemporary satire. An ordinary suburban town, bank, and travel bureaucracy, skewering everyday red tape.

beyondzork.title: Beyond Zork: The Coconut of Quendor
beyondzork.description: Setting: fantasy. The wider Southlands of the Zork universe, blending classic underground-empire exploration with RPG character stats and combat.

borderzone.title: Border Zone
borderzone.description: Setting: Cold War espionage thriller. A fictional Eastern Bloc border town, told across three vignettes from different characters' viewpoints.

sherlock.title: Sherlock: The Riddle of the Crown Jewels
sherlock.description: Setting: Victorian London, 1887. Fog-shrouded streets, Baker Street, and famous London landmarks, in the world of Sherlock Holmes.

plunderedhearts.title: Plundered Hearts
plunderedhearts.description: Setting: 17th-century Caribbean swashbuckling romance. Pirate ships, a tropical island, and a colonial governor's mansion.

journey.title: Journey
journey.description: Setting: high fantasy. A Tolkien-esque land of villages, wilderness, and a wizard's tower, told through a traveling party of companions.

arthur.title: Arthur: The Quest for Excalibur
arthur.description: Setting: legendary early medieval Britain. The countryside and castles of pre-Camelot Arthurian legend.

zorkzero.title: Zork Zero: The Revenge of Megaboz
zorkzero.description: Setting: fantasy. The Great Underground Empire in its opulent heyday, centering on Flatheadia Castle and the reign of the Flathead dynasty.

shogun.title: Shogun
shogun.description: Setting: feudal Japan, 1600. Samurai courts, ships, and villages, dramatizing James Clavell's novel of an English pilot stranded in Japan.
